messages:
Priya Rao: Quick heads-up — I'm doing a sweep for inconsistent phrasing between API docs, SDK snippets, and Console UI. Linter (docs-bot) flagged a few: 'tenant' vs 'workspace', 'customer' vs 'user', and a bunch of CTA verbs (enable vs turn on). I opened a low-risk PR for examples that can be fast-merged: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/452
Alex Chen: Thanks — can you list the highest-priority spots? I can patch SDK snippets if you give the agreed wording. :+1:
Priya Rao: Top three: 1) SDK snippet error messages (should use 'Request failed — try again' style not '501 internal server error'), 2) glossary: prefer 'workspace' over 'tenant' in UI docs, 3) Console buttons should use 'Enable' not 'Turn on'.
Marco Silva: I'll take SDK snippet PRs — which branch? I can update JS/py snippets. Do we standardize casing for param names? We had debate: snake_case in REST vs camelCase in SDK.
Jen Park: For voice/tone: short, active, present tense. For errors: start with outcome then action. E.g. 'Request failed. Retry the request or contact support.' Keep it to one sentence.
Priya Rao: Agree. Here's a microtemplate I want to use for errors: '<Problem>. <Action>.' Example: 'Model request failed. Try again or contact support.'
Marco Silva: OK updating JS and Python snippets. Will open PRs: https://github.com/redwood/sdk-js/pull/78 and https://github.com/redwood/sdk-py/pull/32
Alex Chen: Also fix link text in docs: several 'See here' links flagged. Use descriptive link text: 'Deployments overview' etc.
Jen Park: I'll update the glossary entry draft: workspace vs tenant vs account. Putting copy in https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/453 — please review.
Samir Patel: Minor product note — 'workspace' aligns with Dedicated customers; but some enterprise contracts use 'account' legally. Glossary should include both and usage guidance.
Priya Rao: Good call. In glossary we will list 'account' as legal term, 'workspace' as UI term, and 'customer' as external-facing. Add examples.
docs-bot: :robot_face: Lint report: 12 occurrences of 'tenant', 5 of 'turn on', 9 'See here'. Files: docs/getting-started/*, sdk-examples/*
Alex Chen: Let's do an opt-in sweep: 1) Jen to push glossary PR; 2) Marco + Alex to update SDK snippets; 3) Priya to run final linter; 4) Samir to sign off on wording for enterprise docs. Aim to merge by EOW.
Jen Park: PR opened and assigned: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/453 — note I've added examples mapping with 'legal' vs 'ui' column in the table.
Marco Silva: JS PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/sdk-js/pull/78 — uses new phrasing. Python PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/sdk-py/pull/32
Priya Rao: I ran linter on branch docs/phrase-sweep and fixed 7 instances, left 5 that need product input. Branch: https://github.com/redwood/docs/compare/phrase-sweep
Samir Patel: Reviewed the table, left one comment re: 'customer' in billing page. Will approve after tiny tweak.
Alex Chen: After merges, I'll run a quick script to regenerate code snippets: `scripts/generate-snippets --source=examples --out=site/snippets`
Priya Rao: Can we add a line in the PR template reminding to run snippet generator? Saves future mismatches.
Jen Park: Done — added checkbox in PR template and one-liner in CONTRIBUTING.md
Priya Rao: Great. I'll post an announcement in #docs when everything is merged. Thanks team! :tada:
Marco Silva: :rocket:
Samir Patel: :+1:
docs-bot: :white_check_mark: Lint fixed in CI for PRs 78 and 32.
